description: The bar chart illustrates the execution accuracy of two Text-to-SQL models — NatSQL (light blue) and TA-SQL (dark blue) — across three difficulty levels (Simple, Moderate, Challenging) and an overall Total score, as reported in the paper “Before Generation, Align it! A Novel and Effective Strategy for Mitigating Hallucinations in Text-to-SQL Generation.” The vertical axis represents Execution Accuracy, ranging from 20 to 60 in increments of 10. For the Simple category, NatSQL achieves 60.21% accuracy while TA-SQL reaches 63.14%. In the Moderate category, NatSQL scores 40.00% (with a small gray bar above it, possibly indicating an additional component or error margin, though unlabeled), and TA-SQL scores 48.60%. For Challenging queries, NatSQL attains 32.32% and TA-SQL 36.11%. The Total execution accuracy across all categories is 51.35% for NatSQL and 56.19% for TA-SQL. Across all categories, TA-SQL consistently outperforms NatSQL, with the largest gap observed in the Simple category (2.93 percentage points) and the smallest in the Challenging category (3.79 percentage points). The bars are grouped by difficulty level, with each group containing two adjacent bars for direct comparison, and all values are explicitly labeled atop each bar.
